decision_rule.selected_source_rule: Use a regional/AOI maximum-temperature aggregate for regional heat severity.
decision_rule.rejected_point_rule: Reject a point weather file when it lies outside the AOI and produces a materially cooler heat maximum.
decision_rule.wrong_variable_rule: Reject precipitation or burn-index products for a maximum-temperature heat-severity answer.
